tools.name: context_vault_obs_get
tools.description: Retrieve bounded evidence from an archived Context Vault observation or artifact ID.

tools.name: context_vault_obs_search
tools.description: Search sanitized archived observations. Default terms mode ranks observations that match at least one of up to 32 Unicode-whitespace-separated terms, normalizing common code-identifier separators; phrase mode requires a contiguous literal match within one line. Identical artifacts collapse to the newest Observation with an occurrence count and recent Observation IDs. Results include a relevance score and at most five matching lines per artifact.

tools.name: context_vault_status
tools.description: Report Context Vault Observation storage, reduction, and lifecycle status.

tools.name: repo_context_search
tools.description: Search the live revision-aware repository index with explicit freshness evidence.

tools.name: repo_context_status
tools.description: Report repository index lifecycle, freshness, state, and bounded telemetry.
